replies.author: Miserable_Witness458
replies.body:
Well to be fair when I seriously swing trade I can reach insanity in stats. Literally 0 losses while generating a fair 2-3k daily at least. And without much exposure since it also passed ftmo's 2 steps in a matter of 3-4 days few times just as fine not even reaching the dll/mll by a bit even for few days held trades I tried to try some stuffs. Just had a commission of 100 bucks once still a net 900 though there. Just tried to make the stuff funnier and see if ftmo would be able to handle that fairly without giving me warnings or any soft breaches for holding without obvious reasons and just losing a share of the profits. Since many did complain they were restrictive and still wonder why and how tbf. Even when I troll out on ACC's and give myself a net loss of half the mll in one go they never said a thing. Surely cause I still capped the 2 steps in a matter of 3 days again right away even with a net -3k trade lmao.

On that one acc I used to reach in 5 days ish, about 4 RRR. Others just had theorically jo (or infinite as you wish lol) rr/rrr stats. Simply cause I had not taken losses not even a cent. 

However that is with a controlled environment and a very personal trading strategy I been using since quite a bit and still being somewhat precautious. 

I do know that those traders on some props that can hit 1k%+ generated profits off initial balance are all based on ai/algos xauusd. Which I'd personally consider even with their results being legitimately insane, still, being a risk I wouldn't take. Especially gold related and more so if the algo can't effectively handle the risk management and any volatility shift out of a sudden like let's say news related, that can literally smoke one's algo positions. Heck even humans that do take precautions can easily get wiped out in an instant 

There he is paper trading didn't check but he may also be backtesting as well. Which is another terrible way to give your trust over an algo, ai or not. Excellent results in backtesting is just an indicator. All those that went all-in due to backtesting being perfect or at least the wide majority off em, just went blindly in facts, and made a terrible mistake. Believing it's gonna predict the current and close or even maybe long term future shifts/whatever. When in fact it does not. Many forgets that they're just meant to be an indicator and some tool to help building the concept but definitely not the live behaviour in itself.

Anyways. If he does adapt it to the live markets ideally with those 1ms VPS so he can get the best off it, and add a risk management system ideally akin to what's suggested by props like 1-2% max losses, that may be okayish if he bases itself on EMA's. What would scare me is if he gone full vibecoding clueless about coding and using generic ais cause I believe I saw gamma's name. No way I'd use that as an model personally lmfao. Guess he does use it for the ready to go AI's driven engine and their datas like sentiment based datas and scalping engine. Plus signals as well. They do have few okay metrics and event driven strategies that could be okay since it's just based off the actual news, economical, and FED related as well. So dunno if jevuses gamma as the actual one api that does trade there out or if he combines their datas with an actual AI that process it again like at least double checking and not going blind on the recommendations but rather use it as what they are. Suggested opportunities. Do know some llms that could use that and make it worthwhile so yeh. But ideally a few more sources would be ideal, even just one more. Edgeful got their agentic up not long ago idk what's it's worth yet but that might sound like a good option and that's on their 49$ plan already. Limited but available. And would support futures as well as forex so win win.
